R code used to generate Figure 5A and 5B

```{r, eval = F}
.vsc.attach()
setwd("R-QSS/niche_shadow_sim")
```

```{r imports}
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(khroma)

config = "rust_config.json"

source("utils.R")
```

## Small kernel, visualizing initial decrease
```{r start}
desc <- "smallmut_0.001"
result <- paste0("results/", desc, ".json")
if (!file.exists(result)) {
  writeConfig(
    config,
    desc,
    mortality = 24.1225,
    mut_stdev = 0.001,
    mut_uniform = 0.0,
    write_every = 10,
    rounds = 100000,
    initial = 0.11
    #initial = 0.211586
  )
  command <- sprintf(
    r"[cargo run --release --bin siderophoreQSS --manifest-path ../../rust/Cargo.toml -- %s %s]",
    config, result
  )
  code <- system(command)
}

points <- read.csv(result, comment.char = "#")
```

```{r, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 6}
points$frequency <- points$frequency * 10000

tol = khroma::color("iridescent")

plt1 <- ggplot(points, aes(x = time, y = alpha)) +
#plt1 <- ggplot(points, aes(x = time, y = alpha)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.2) +
  labs(
    x = "Simulation time",
    y = "Siderophore investment α of surviving strains",
    color = "Patch\nOccupancy"
  ) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = tol(23)[10:23],
                        trans = "log",
                        limits = c(1, 10000),
                        breaks = c(1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000)) +
  #coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 10000), ylim = c(0, 0.11)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 10000), ylim = c(0, 0.11)) +
  #scale_x_continuous(limits = c(900000, 1000000), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "inside",
        legend.position.inside = c(0.7, 0.8)) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1, text = element_text(family = "sans"))

plt1
```

zoom in on packing
```{r, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 6}
plt2 <- ggplot(points, aes(x = time, y = alpha)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    x = "Simulation time",
    y = "Siderophore investment α of surviving strains",
    color = "Patch\nOccupancy"
  ) +
  # scale_color_gradientn(colors = tol(23)[10:23],
  #                       trans = "log",
  #                       limits = c(0.0001, 1),
  #                       breaks = c(0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1),
  #                       labels = c("0.0001", 0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(1600, 1600), ylim = c(0.0, 0.084)) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.1))) +
  guides(color = FALSE) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1, text = element_text(family = "sans"))
plt2
```


## Small kernel, keep going
```{r start}
desc <- "smallmut_long"
result <- paste0("results/", desc, ".json")
if (!file.exists(result)) {
  writeConfig(
    config,
    desc,
    mortality = 24.1225,
    mut_stdev = 0.001,
    mut_uniform = 0.0,
    write_every = 100,
    rounds = 10000000,
    initial = 0.1
    #initial = 0.211586
  )
  command <- sprintf(
    r"[cargo run --release --bin siderophoreQSS --manifest-path ../../rust/Cargo.toml -- %s %s]",
    config, result
  )
  code <- system(command)
}

points <- read.csv(result, comment.char = "#")
```

```{r, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 6}
points$frequency <- points$frequency * 10000

tol = khroma::color("iridescent")

plt1 <- ggplot(points, aes(x = time, y = alpha)) +
#plt1 <- ggplot(points, aes(x = time, y = alpha)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.2) +
  labs(
    x = "Simulation time",
    y = "Siderophore investment α of surviving strains",
    color = "Patch\nOccupancy"
  ) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = tol(23)[10:23],
                        trans = "log",
                        limits = c(1, 10000),
                        breaks = c(1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(10000000-100000, 10000000), ylim = c(0, 0.1)) +
  #scale_x_continuous(limits = c(900000, 1000000), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "inside",
        legend.position.inside = c(0.7, 0.8)) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1, text = element_text(family = "sans"))

plt1
```
